methods.description: One directional vote per hard stance; IRRELEVANT contributes no direction.
methods.name: unweighted_hard_stance_majority

methods.description: Sum frozen evidence-quality scores by hard directional stance.
methods.name: quality_weighted_hard_stance

methods.description: Use frozen q*(1-H3) weights with soft SUPPORT-minus-CONTRADICT direction.
methods.name: quality_uncertainty_weighted_soft_stance

aggregation_preparation.precise_gap: The frozen 60-pair input projection has neither evidence_type metadata (needed by the existing frozen quality scorer) nor a frozen quality_score. It is a stance-reference subset (50 question-option groups), not a declared complete retrieval-evidence set for every answer option. Quality-weighted aggregation cannot be compared without the frozen evidence grouping and quality metadata.

metric_definitions.auroc: Pairwise ranking probability; exact score ties receive half credit.
metric_definitions.average_precision: Stepwise average precision with identical uncertainty scores grouped.
metric_definitions.coverage_rounding: retained count is ceil(n * requested coverage)
metric_definitions.empirical_probabilities: ten-seed relative frequencies; not calibrated probabilities
metric_definitions.error_prevalence_baseline: fraction of evaluable completed pairs with error=1
metric_definitions.positive_class: error=1 when frozen Qwen-v1 hard stance != adjudicated reference stance
metric_definitions.selective_accuracy: accuracy after retaining the lowest-uncertainty pairs at prespecified coverage
metric_definitions.u_directional: binary entropy after conditioning on SUPPORT or CONTRADICT; 1 when directional mass is zero
metric_definitions.zero_directional_contribution: directional_score=0 when all ten samples are IRRELEVANT

reference.provenance: AI-assisted adjudicated stance reference set; not independent clinician annotation

reference_label_isolation.source: checkpoint leakage_audit.json plus validated input/prompt allowlists

timestamp_source: source checkpoint manifest (used for deterministic reruns)
